exposure: Time periods (before and during the COVID-19 pandemic)
outcome: Perinatal mortality (early neonatal death, fresh stillbirths, macerated stillbirths)
cohort: Pregnant women and newborns at Tamale Teaching Hospital in northern Ghana (n=52,136 total antenatal visits and deliveries)
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic had a negative impact on perinatal care and outcomes, with declines observed in antenatal care attendance, total deliveries, and increases in perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections showed a rapid decline after the onset of the pandemic.
